$comment: The JS budget (scorecard dimension 5; docs/research/ui-performance.md, 'Bundle'). Sizes are KB of gzip -6 per built file. Checked by `node tools/perf/bundle.mjs <dist> --check` (tools/check.sh, step perf:bundle).
$defaultRouteParts: Lazy entries the default route fetches as it renders (its parameter form, a lazy boundary of its own): checked like any lazy entry and, together with the route, against routeKB (bundle.mjs --check: the split must not hide the route's size); reported with the route and counted in the route's share of the measured first view.

exempt.src/canvas/ui/Editor.tsx: the canvas editor (Konva and the editor UI): an editor chunk, loaded when an image editor opens (img2img preloads it)
the prompt editor (CodeMirror): an editor chunk, loaded by the prompt fields
exempt.src/ui/prompt/PromptEditor.tsx: the prompt editor's entry for schema text fields with prompt: true (the same CodeMirror chunks)
